displayName: Recipe: free recipes (welcome grant) day limit

documentation.content: Today's welcome grants reached half of `config/runtime.welcome.perDay` (`welcome_threshold`, `percent` 50) or all of it (`welcome_day_limit`, `event` reached: new sign-ins get no free recipes until 00:00 UTC). Each fires once per UTC day. Check `welcome_granted` for farming (many grants, little revenue) and the owner board. See functions/README.md, "Welcome grant".
